14| def get_version(version=None, release=None):
15|     """Derives a PEP386-compliant version number from VERSION."""
16| 
17|     if version is None:
18|         version = VERSION
19|     if release is None:
20|         release = RELEASE
21|     assert len(version) == 5
22|     assert version[3] in ('alpha', 'beta', 'rc', 'final')
23| 
24|     # Now build the two parts of the version number:
25|     # main = X.Y[.Z]
26|     # sub = .devN - for pre-alpha releases
27|     #     | {a|b|c}N - for alpha, beta and rc releases
28| 
29|     main_parts = 2 if version[2] == 0 else 3
30|     main = '.'.join(str(x) for x in version[:main_parts])
31| 
32|     if version[3] != 'final':
33|         mapping = {'alpha': 'a', 'beta': 'b', 'rc': 'rc'}
34|         sub = mapping[version[3]] + str(version[4])
35|     else:
36|         sub = ''
37|     if not release:
38|         sub += '.dev0'
39| 
40|     return main + sub

434|     def calculate_bmi(self):
435|         """
436|         Calculates the user's BMI
437| 
438|         Formula: weight/height^2
439|         - weight in kg
440|         - height in m
441|         """
442| 
443|         # If not all the data is available, return 0, otherwise the result
444|         # of the calculation below breaks django's template filters
445|         if not self.weight or not self.height:
446|             return 0
447| 
448|         weight = self.weight if self.use_metric else AbstractWeight(self.weight, 'lb').kg
449|         return weight / pow(self.height / decimal.Decimal(100), 2)
450| 
451|     def calculate_basal_metabolic_rate(self, formula=1):
452|         """
453|         Calculates the basal metabolic rate.
454| 
455|         Currently only the Mifflin-St.Jeor formula is supported
456|         """
457|         factor = 5 if self.gender == self.GENDER_MALE else -161
458|         weight = self.weight if self.use_metric else AbstractWeight(self.weight, 'lb').kg
459| 
460|         try:
461|             rate = (
462|                 (10 * weight)  # in kg
463|                 + (decimal.Decimal(6.25) * self.height)  # in cm
464|                 - (5 * self.age)  # in years
465|                 + factor
466|             )
467|         # Any of the entries is missing
468|         except TypeError:
469|             rate = 0
470| 
471|         return decimal.Decimal(str(rate)).quantize(TWOPLACES)
472| 
473|     def calculate_activities(self):
474|         """
475|         Calculates the calories needed by additional physical activities
476| 
477|         Factors taken from
478|         * https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Physical_activity_level
479|         * http://www.fao.org/docrep/007/y5686e/y5686e07.htm
480|         """
481|         # Sleep
482|         sleep = self.sleep_hours * 0.95
483| 
484|         # Work
485|         if self.work_intensity == self.INTENSITY_LOW:
486|             work_factor = 1.5
487|         elif self.work_intensity == self.INTENSITY_MEDIUM:
488|             work_factor = 1.8
489|         else:
490|             work_factor = 2.2
491|         work = self.work_hours * work_factor
492| 
493|         # Sport (entered in hours/week, so we must divide)
494|         if self.sport_intensity == self.INTENSITY_LOW:
495|             sport_factor = 4
496|         elif self.sport_intensity == self.INTENSITY_MEDIUM:
497|             sport_factor = 6
498|         else:
499|             sport_factor = 10
500|         sport = (self.sport_hours / 7.0) * sport_factor
501| 
502|         # Free time
503|         if self.freetime_intensity == self.INTENSITY_LOW:
504|             freetime_factor = 1.3
505|         elif self.freetime_intensity == self.INTENSITY_MEDIUM:
506|             freetime_factor = 1.9
507|         else:
508|             freetime_factor = 2.4
509|         freetime = self.freetime_hours * freetime_factor
510| 
511|         # Total
512|         total = (sleep + work + sport + freetime) / 24.0
513|         return decimal.Decimal(str(total)).quantize(TWOPLACES)

529|             entry.save()
530| 
531|         # Update the last entry
532|         else:
533|             entry = WeightEntry.objects.filter(user=self.user).latest()
534|             entry.weight = weight
535|             entry.save()
536|         return entry
